ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p175/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p175/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p175/r3.claim: Noah first gently invites them to fear God, then directly commands it and obedience to his advice and call to exclusive worship.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p175/r3.anchor: ولما عرض عليهم برفق تقوى الله فقال: ألا تتقون، انتقل من العرض إلى الأمر

RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r9.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r9.claim: The repeated call to fear God has distinct grounds: first, they should not disobey God’s messenger; again, they should not disobey a messenger who asks no wage. Rāzī compares this to repeating a rebuke for separate reasons.
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r9.anchor: لأنه في الأول أراد ألا تتقون مخالفتي وأنا رسول الله

RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r10.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r10.claim: Noah places fear of God before obedience to himself because piety is the cause of obedience, so the cause precedes its consequence.
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r10.anchor: الأمر بطاعته ، لأن تقوى الله علة لطاعته فقدم العلة على المعلول

BURSEVI:v6p211#4/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p211#4/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p211#4/r3.claim: Noah calls them to fear God and obey him in monotheism and obedience, since he will neither betray nor harm them; the fa follows from his trustworthiness.
BURSEVI:v6p211#4/r3.anchor: فإني لا أخونكم ولا أريدكم بسوء والفاء لترتيب ما بعدها على الأمانة.

BURSEVI:v6p211#5/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p211#5/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p211#5/r1.claim: The repeated command follows from Noah’s lack of greed; repetition emphasizes that trustworthiness and refusal of payment each independently require obedience.
BURSEVI:v6p211#5/r1.anchor: الفاء لترتيب ما بعدها على تنزهه عن الطمع والتكرير للتأكيد والتنبيه على أن كلا من الأمانة وقطع الطمع مستقل في إيجاب التقوى والطاعة

STUDYQURAN:26:107/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:107/r2.speaker: R
STUDYQURAN:26:107/r2.claim: The call to reverence God comes before obedience to Noah because obedience depends on reverence.
STUDYQURAN:26:107/r2.anchor: The call to reverence God precedes the call to obey Noah, because the latter depends upon the former (R).

STUDYQURAN:26:107/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:107/r3.speaker: Q
STUDYQURAN:26:107/r3.claim: The people were to obey Noah when he called them to faith.
STUDYQURAN:26:107/r3.anchor: The people were to obey Noah when he enjoined them to faith (Q).

TABATABAI:26:105-110/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r1.claim: After the stories of Moses and Abraham, the account turns to Noah, the first of the foremost prophets; most of his people disbelieved, so God drowned them and saved Noah and the believers with him.
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r1.anchor: وهو أول أولي العزم سادة الأنبياء

TABATABAI:26:105-110/r10.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r10.speaker: author
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r10.claim: Noah is a trustworthy messenger who conveys only what God commanded; therefore he tells them to fear God and obey him, since obedience to the messenger is obedience to God.
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r10.anchor: أي رسول من الله سبحانه أمين على ما حملته من الرسالة لا أبلغكم إلا ما أمرني ربي

TABRISI:26:105-111/r18.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:26:105-111/r18.speaker: author
TABRISI:26:105-111/r18.claim: He calls them to obey and worship God and obey him by accepting faith and divine unity.
TABRISI:26:105-111/r18.anchor: فيما آمركم به من الإيمان والتوحيد

TABRISI:26:105-111/r20.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:26:105-111/r20.speaker: author
TABRISI:26:105-111/r20.claim: Noah repeats the appeal for two reasons: he is a trustworthy messenger, and he seeks no wage that might make them fear losing their wealth.
TABRISI:26:105-111/r20.anchor: لأني لا أسألكم عليه أجرا فتخافوا تلف أموالكم به

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83#2/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83#2/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83#2/r1.claim: Fear God by obeying and worshipping Him.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83#2/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83#2/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83#2/r2.claim: Obey Noah in his command to believe and affirm God's oneness.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83#2/r2.anchor: {وأطيعون} فيما آمركم به من الإيمان والتوحيد

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r4.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r4.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r4.claim: Noah asks no payment for the guidance he brought; his reward is recompense from the Lord of the worlds.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r4.anchor: {فاتقوا الله وأطيعون {108} وما أسألكم عليه} [الشعراء: 108-109] على ما جئتكم به من الهدى. {من أجر إن أجري} [الشعراء: 109] إن ثوابي.

ELMALILI:26:105-122/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r5.claim: Noah urges them to fear God and obey him.
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r5.anchor: Gelin Allah’tan korkun, bana itaat edin (108).

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.claim: Noah’s call has the same essential principles as Moses’s and Abraham’s, and their peoples’ beliefs and responses to true religion were alike; the three narrative groups deliver the same message.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.anchor: Sonuç itibariyle her üç peygambere dair âyetler grubunda da aynı mesajlar verilmiştir

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p427/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p427/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p427/r5.claim: To escape God's punishment, the people must abandon rebellion, fear God's grasp, obey Noah, and stop following rebellious leaders who lead them to destruction.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p427/r5.anchor: The way to do this is to obey Noah (sws) and stop following these rebellious people who were leading them to destruction

NASHR:v2p336/r10.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p336/r10.speaker: يعقوب
NASHR:v2p336/r10.claim: Yaqub affirms the sixteen listed extra yāʾs in both connected and pause forms: the eight quoted forms plus أطيعون in eight places.
NASHR:v2p336/r10.anchor: أثبت الياء في جميعها يعقوب في الحالين

QIRAAT-ER:26:108:5#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:26:108:5#1/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:26:108:5#1/r1.claim: The reading explicitly retains the full first-person yāʾ, lengthening the final syllable without changing meaning.
QIRAAT-ER:26:108:5#1/r1.anchor: Full yāʾ al-mutakallim explicitly written — no semantic change but prosodic lengthening

ALUSI-FULL:v19p107#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p107#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p107#2/r1.claim: Noah calls them to fear God and obey him in his command to monotheism and obedience to God.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p107#2/r1.anchor: فيما أمركم من التوحيد والطاعة لله تعالى

ALUSI-FULL:v19p107#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p107#2/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p107#2/r2.claim: Fear of God is placed before obedience to Noah because piety is the cause of obeying him.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p107#2/r2.anchor: وقدم الأمر بتقوى الله تعالى على الأمر بالطاعة لأن تقوى الله تعالى سبب لطاعته عليه السلام

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r3.claim: Fearing God means obeying and worshipping Him; obeying Noah means following his call to faith and monotheism.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r3.anchor: {فاتقوا الله} بطاعته وعبادته، {وأطيعون} فيما آمركم به من الإيمان والتوحيد.

BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r6.claim: He commands them to obey him in monotheism and obedience to God.
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r6.anchor: فيما آمركم به من التوحيد والطاعة لله سبحانه.

BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r8.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r8.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r8.claim: Noah repeats the command: his trustworthiness and lack of desire for payment each separately establish obedience, and together strengthen the case.
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r8.anchor: كرره للتأكيد والتنبيه على دلالة كل واحد من أمانته وحسم طمعه على وجوب طاعته

BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r1.claim: After the gentle invitation and proof of his trustworthiness, Noah gives a decisive command: fear God through monotheism for salvation, and obey him in all commands to avoid punishment.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p374/r1.anchor: بما ثبت به أمرها , تسبب عنه الجزم بالأمر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p159/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p159/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p159/r1.claim: The command reiterates ألا تتقون and interrupts two coordinated clauses; Noah repeats the call after its explanation, after saying he seeks no wage, and again as the speech’s conclusion.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p159/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p159/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p159/r2.claim: The yāʾ of the first-person suffix is omitted from أطيعون in both occurrences, as in 26:14.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p159/r2.anchor: في الموضعين كما حذفت في قوله

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r5.claim: His renewed call to fear God and obey him is a warning and an expression of earnest concern for his people.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r5.anchor: ثم رد عليهم الأمر بالتقوى والدعاء إلى طاعته تحذيرا ونذارة وحرصا عليهم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p150#3/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p150#3/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p150#3/r5.claim: Noah asks them to fear God and obey him, explaining that he seeks no payment for advising them and keeps his reward with the Lord of all worlds.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p150#3/r5.anchor: لا أطلب منكم جزاء على نصحي لكم، بل أدخر ثواب ذلك عند الله

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r6.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r6.claim: “Obey me” means follow Noah's counsel and the truth to which he calls them.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r6.anchor: { وأطيعون } في نصحي لكم وفيما أدعوكم إليه من الحق

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r8.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r8.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r8.claim: Noah means they should fear God by obeying him; he repeats the command to reinforce it in their minds.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r8.anchor: ومعنى : { فاتقوا الله وأطيعون } : فاتقوا الله في طاعتي ، وكرره ليؤكده عليهم

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r9.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r9.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r9.claim: Each repetition has a distinct rationale: Noah's trustworthiness and his renunciation of any expectation from them.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r9.anchor: مع تعليق كل واحدة منهما بعلة ، جعل علة الأول كونه أمينا فيما بينهم

MUQATIL:26:105-111/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:26:105-111/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:26:105-111/r5.claim: “Fear God” means worship God; obey Noah in the counsel he gives.
MUQATIL:26:105-111/r5.anchor: يعنى فاعبدوا الله { وأطيعون } [آية: 108] فيما آمركم به من النصيحة

NASAFI-FULL:v3p191#7/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p191#7/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p191#7/r1.claim: Noah tells them to fear God and obey him in the truth he commands and calls them to.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p191#7/r1.anchor: فيما آمركم به وأدعوكم اليه من الحق

QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r4.claim: Piety means sheltering yourselves from God’s punishment through obedience.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r4.anchor: { فاتقوا الله } أي فاستتروا بطاعة الله تعالى من عقابه.

QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r5.claim: Noah’s call to obey him means obeying his command to believe.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r5.anchor: { وأطيعون } فيما آمركم به من الإيمان.

QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r8.claim: The repeated command to fear God and obey Noah is for emphasis.
